title: Bell and Choir
author: Wendell Vane
blurb: Ulyana Coldharbour, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
